verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes clearly support executing arbitrary code/commands via custom images and have SDKs for Python, JS, and Go, letting developers run 'any dependency' language (modal-docs-2, modal-docs-19, modal-gh-1, modal-docs-21). However, the exec API returns subprocess-style stdout/stderr (like asyncio.subprocess.Process, modal-docs-25) rather than documented 'rich results' (e.g., images, dataframes, structured outputs) as in dedicated code-interpreter products. Missing for 10: evidence of rich/structured result formatting (images, plots, dataframes) rather than raw text streams, and broader language runtime examples beyond Python/JS/Go.
